description.value: Sector 7 Kitchen + Bar is a full-service restaurant and bar in Richmond's arts and culture district, offering an extensive menu of creative craft cocktails alongside a burger-focused food menu. The restaurant emphasizes community connection, local and sustainable sourcing, and an atmosphere where food and art intersect. It also accommodates corporate events, private events, and catering, making it a versatile dining destination.

address.value: 9371 No 5 Rd Unit 10, Richmond, BC V7A 4E1, Canada
